title: Christmas 1914 vs. Christmas 2026
caption:
Christmas 1914 vs. Christmas today. The Christmas truce really happened – a true story. 🕯️

If enemies managed it in 1914: who stands up first in your family? Tell us in the comments 👇

Maybe peace isn't a miracle that happens once. Maybe it's waiting in every one of us.

"The First to Stand Up" – the whole true story as a book.
🇩🇪 Auch auf Deutsch: „Wer zuerst aufsteht“
🇫🇷 Aussi en français : « Le Premier à se lever »

l.text: Enemies sing carols to each other across no man's land.

r.text: We argue about whether the tree is crooked.

l.text: They swap cigars, chocolate and plum pudding.

r.text: We return our presents on the 27th.

l.text: They play football in no man's land.

r.text: We fight about football at the dinner table.

l.text: They shake hands with the enemy.

r.text: We haven't called our brother in three years.

slides.text: They did it in 1914. Who stands up first in your family?
